name: Brookside Camp
description: A small woodcutters' camp beside a clear brook. There is a fire and a dry place to sleep.

name: Elderwood Village
description: A hidden settlement in the roots of a giant tree. The villagers offer a market and warm beds.

name: Trader's Outpost
description: A lonely trading post at the edge of the Serpent's Domain. No beds, only wares.

name: Lantern Post
description: Rangers keep a lantern burning at this crossroads. They sell supplies and share their fire.

name: Charcoal Burners' Camp
description: Smoke curls from the kilns. The burners offer a place by the embers, nothing more.
